title: Rav Sheshet son of Rav Yehoshua
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesachim 115a; Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be Rav Shisha son of Rav Idi, as in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Pesachim 115a reads Rav Sheshet son of Rav Yehoshua, agreeing with the supplied heading. Shisha son of Rav Idi is Hyman’s proposed replacement, attributed by him to Dikdukei Soferim.

The whole Davidson Pesachim 115a paragraph fully writes Rav Sheshet son of Rav Yehoshua. The replacement Rav Shisha son of Rav Idi and scribal-error/SHOULD READ force remain Hyman’s statement about Dikdukei Soferim, which was not freshly collated. The current mixed note stays verbatim and no patronymic or identity is harmonized.
